当开发者需要通过应用内广告实现流量变现时，应使用Ads Kit
如果你的应用需要展示横幅广告、插屏广告、激励广告、开屏广告、原生广告或贴片广告中的任何一种，Ads Kit提供了完整的接入指导和API
适用于免费应用通过广告变现、游戏应用通过激励广告提供虚拟奖励、内容类应用通过开屏广告和原生广告展示品牌推广等场景
当开发者需要获取设备标识符用于广告投放和归因分析时，应使用Ads Kit的开放匿名设备标识服务
如果你需要实现个性化广告推荐或转化跟踪，OAID提供了符合隐私规范的设备标识解决方案
当你需要在鲸鸿动能平台上进行广告开发和调试时，Ads Kit提供了开发准备、实时竞价接入和常见问题排查的完整指导
接入开屏广告并在应用启动时展示 / Integrate splash ads and show them on app launch
在列表页嵌入原生广告卡片 / Embed native ad cards in a feed or list page
实现横幅广告自动加载与定时刷新 / Implement banner ad auto-loading and timed refresh
在页面切换时展示插屏广告 / Show interstitial ads during page transitions
接入激励视频广告解锁金币或会员权益 / Integrate rewarded video ads to unlock coins or premium benefits
监听广告加载、点击、关闭和发奖回调 / Handle ad load, click, close, and reward callbacks
获取 OAID 用于广告归因和个性化投放 / Obtain OAID for ad attribution and personalized delivery
配置广告位 ID 并请求对应类型的广告素材 / Configure ad slot IDs and request creatives for specific ad formats
实现广告预加载减少展示等待时间 / Preload ads to reduce wait time before display
接入实时竞价广告提升广告填充率和收益 / Integrate real-time bidding ads to improve fill rate and revenue
处理激励广告服务端验证防止刷奖励 / Implement server-side verification for rewarded ads to prevent reward abuse
排查广告展示失败、白屏和错误码问题 / Troubleshoot ad display failures, blank screens, and error codes
do_not_use_when: 需求是处理订单交易、数字人民币收款、身份校验或优惠券营销能力，应改用 payment-kit / The task involves order transactions, e-CNY payment, identity verification, or coupon-based marketing capabilities; use payment-kit instead
需求是购买消耗型、非消耗型或订阅型数字商品，并管理购买状态与发货流程，应改用 iap-kit / The need is to sell consumables, non-consumables, or subscriptions and manage purchase state and fulfillment; use iap-kit instead
preconditions: 项目已集成Ads Kit相关SDK与依赖，并在DevEco/工程配置中启用对应能力 / The project has integrated Ads Kit SDK dependencies and enabled the required capability in project configuration
开发者已在鲸鸿动能媒体服务平台完成应用与广告位配置，具备有效的广告位ID / The developer has configured the app and ad slots in the HMS Ads platform and has valid ad slot IDs
设备网络可用，且广告请求所需的华为移动服务环境可正常访问 / Network connectivity is available and the Huawei Mobile Services environment required for ad requests is reachable

若涉及OAID或个性化广告，应用已完成隐私声明与用户同意流程并满足相关权限/合规要求 / If OAID or personalized ads are involved, the app has completed privacy disclosure and user consent flow and meets related permission/compliance requirements
inputs: 页面上下文或UI容器 / page context or UI container
广告请求参数与监听回调 / ad request parameters and event callbacks
OAID获取请求或归因相关配置 / OAID request or attribution-related configuration

postconditions.statement: 工程中已加入Ads Kit接入代码，并引用了对应广告或OAID能力的API / The project contains Ads Kit integration code and references the relevant ad or OAID APIs
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code/configuration that clearly integrates HarmonyOS Ads Kit APIs for ad loading/showing or OAID retrieval?

postconditions.statement: 已配置可用于请求广告的关键参数（如广告位ID、请求配置或回调处理） / Key parameters required to request ads (such as ad slot ID, request config, or callback handling) are configured
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there clear evidence that ad request essentials such as slot IDs, request options, or event callback handlers were added or wired up?

postconditions.statement: 若实现激励、插屏、横幅、开屏、原生或贴片广告，代码中已包含对应展示流程或事件处理 / If implementing rewarded, interstitial, banner, splash, native, or instream ads, the code includes the corresponding display flow or event handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the changes show ad-type-specific logic for displaying the selected ad format and handling its lifecycle/events?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及OAID，已加入获取标识符的调用，并未将其替换为无关Kit的能力 / If OAID is involved, a call to obtain the identifier is added and it is not substituted with an unrelated Kit's capability
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task mentions OAID or attribution, do the edits add OAID retrieval logic specifically via Ads Kit rather than unrelated kits or generic placeholders?
